CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMER_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Customer
AS(
    SELECT DISTINCT
    BCA.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCA.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,LEFT(BCA.ORGKEY,1) AS CustomerTypeId
    ,SGC.GLOBAL_CIF AS PartyId
    ,BCA.PRIMARY_SOL_ID AS BranchId
    ,BCA.STRUSERFIELD10 AS CustomerCreationModeId
    ,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCA.ENTITY_CRE_FLAG AS EntityCreationIndicator
    ,BCA.SUSPENDED AS SuspendedIndicator
    ,BCA.CORE_CUST_ID AS CoreCustomerId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCAD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCA.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS_DELTA BCAD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS BCA ON BCAD.ACCOUNTID = BCA.ACCOUNTID AND BCAD.BANK_ID = BCA.BANK_ID AND BCA.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN SYN.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE SGC ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.ACCOUNTID) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,REPLACE(SGC.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,'CBC_CRM_',''))

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Customer FROM TEMP_BNKM_Customer;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_Customer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId 
,CustomerEstablishedDate 
,CustomerTypeId 
,BranchId 
,CustomerCreationModeId 
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,EntityCreationIndicator 
,SuspendedIndicator 
,CoreCustomerId 
,SourceSystemCode
)) HASHROW, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Customer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Customer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId 
,CustomerEstablishedDate 
,CustomerTypeId 
,BranchId 
,CustomerCreationModeId 
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,EntityCreationIndicator 
,SuspendedIndicator 
,CoreCustomerId 
,SourceSystemCode
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.Customer --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_Customer_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_Customer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
CustomerEstablishedDate = SRC.CustomerEstablishedDate  
,CustomerTypeId = SRC.CustomerTypeId  
,PartyId = SRC.PartyId
,BranchId = SRC.BranchId  
,CustomerCreationModeId = SRC.CustomerCreationModeId  
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId  
,EntityCreationIndicator = SRC.EntityCreationIndicator  
,SuspendedIndicator = SRC.SuspendedIndicator  
,CoreCustomerId = SRC.CoreCustomerId  
FROM BNKM.Customer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Customer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Customer
(CustomerId ,CustomerEstablishedDate ,CustomerTypeId , PartyId, BranchId ,CustomerCreationModeId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,EntityCreationIndicator ,SuspendedIndicator ,CoreCustomerId ,SourceSystemCode
,SourceCode
,WorkFlowId 
,TaskRunId 
,InsertDttm )

SELECT
     CustomerId 
    ,CustomerEstablishedDate 
    ,CustomerTypeId 
    ,PartyId
    ,BranchId 
    ,CustomerCreationModeId 
    ,FinancialInstitutionId 
    ,EntityCreationIndicator 
    ,SuspendedIndicator 
    ,CoreCustomerId 
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,'CRM' AS SourceCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Customer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Customer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA;

END
